mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 115), a subsequent decline in industrial output signals an imminent supply shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 115 and INDPRO declines from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115 and declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth (PAYEMS) over the prior three months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal severe economic contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing that reduces cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and FEDFUNDS declines from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
